traces.requirement: The frozen changes.recovery.v1 envelope shape, bounded payloads, schema/revision validation, and stable corruption codes.
The frozen sha256-of-sorted-key-json-without-checksum-v1 algorithm detects truncation and corruption and is independently recomputable.
Immediate pending mark, 400 ms idle write, two-second maximum under continuous editing, one in-flight write, visibility-change best-effort flush.
Snapshots bind their triggering revision; older completions can never mark or overwrite newer state; rotation is atomic.
IndexedDB primary, probe-gated bounded localStorage fallback, dumb bounded byte-store ports, schema-prefixed keys without user text.
Editing continues under denied storage, quota, and double probe failure with the exact unavailable vocabulary; failed writes leave slots unchanged.
traces.parentSource: A1 invariants: editing must continue when storage is denied/quota/corruption occurs

traces.requirement: The exact startup matrix: automatic open, Keep/Discard, previous offer, unrecoverable diagnostic, none-available; blank-first, no audio, no silent overwrite.
Exact-success export binding storage, derived lastExport subset, stale-marker refusal, cancellation/failure never advancing the marker.
traces.parentSource: A1 required implementation and REBUILD_PLAN 15.2 export discipline

traces.requirement: The five frozen user-facing status strings with only {time}/{revision} substitutions; recovery is never called Save.

Real-browser reload E2E under IndexedDB, forced failure with localStorage fallback, quota, corrupt current with valid previous, and visibility-change flush, logging revisions/hashes/adapter transitions without chart text.
The legacy no-recovery class cannot recur: ordinary edits are never lost without recovery — a mutation is pending immediately, written within bounded delay, and recoverable after reload.
traces.parentSource: docs/LEGACY_AUDIT.md — no local recovery, autosave, or dirty indicator; ordinary edits can be lost without recovery
